### Weekly Schedule (Mon – Sun)

| Day | Time | Priority | Main Task | Notes |
|-----|------|----------|-----------|-------|
| **Monday** | 7:00 AM – 8:00 AM | ⏫ | Gym |  |
|  | 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM | ⏫ | Seatbelt README (write, review, PR) | Focus in a quiet space. |
|  | 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM | ⏫ | Accounts work | Update budgets, pay bills, backlink analysis. |
|  | 3:00 PM – 4:30 PM | ⏫ | Finish README | Add diagrams, usage examples, testing section. |
|  | 4:30 PM – 6:00 PM | ⏪ | Review & backup documents | Save to cloud, commit to repo. |
|  | 6:00 PM – 7:30 PM | 🎧 | Relax / Light meal | Wind‑down after work. |
|  | 7:30 PM – 9:00 PM | 🎬 | Optional “Weekend prep” | Light prep for weekend, nothing heavy. |
| **Tuesday** | 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM | ⏫ | Deep work: Reading, learning | Standhouse patterns, TDD books. |
|  | 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM | ⏫ | Accounts work (if not done) | Final check‑in/closing. |
|  | 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM | ⚙️ | Continue README | Polish language, add TODO list. |
|  | 5:00 PM – 6:30 PM | ⏪ | Backup & sync | Ensure everything in version control. |
| **Wednesday** | 7:00 AM – 8:00 AM | ⏫ | Gym |  |
|  | 9:00 AM – 11:00 AM | ⏫ | Finish README | Commit push, add reviewers. |
|  | 11:00 AM – 1:00 PM | ⚙️ | Accounts check | Quick audit, set next month’s goals. |
|  | 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM | ⏫ | Prepare presentation / deliverable | Maybe summarise README in slide form. |
| **Thursday** | 9:00 AM – 11:00 AM | ⏫ | Accounts *final wrap‑up* | Confirm all tasks done by end of day. |
|  | 11:00 AM – 1:00 PM | 🎨 | Creative time | Update wiki, brainstorm future features. |
|  | 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM | ⏪ | Documentation polishing | Push final README, update changelog. |
|  | 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM | ⏫ | Backup & security check | Scan for SSL, code reviews. |
| **Friday** | 7:00 AM – 8:00 AM | ⏫ | Gym |  |
|  | 9:00 AM – 11:00 AM | 🎉 | Wrap‑up week | Celebrate accomplishments, copy notes. |
|  | 1:00 PM – 4:00 PM | ⚡ | Buffer / contingency | Handle any overflow from accounts or documentation. |
|  | 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM | 🍕 | Plan next week | Draft high‑level goals for Monday. |
| **Saturday** | 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM | 🎈 | Free | No scheduled tasks. Feel free to rest, explore, or revisit in a relaxed manner. |
| **Sunday** | 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM | 🎈 | Free | Stay off critical work; recharge. |

**Key Points**
1. **Gym**: 7 AM on Mon, Wed, Fri – 1 hour each.
2. **Seatbelt README**: by end of Wednesday (or Friday if you need a buffer).
3. **Accounts**: completed by Thursday afternoon.
4. **Weekend**: completely free – no work scheduled. Enjoy!
